statement: ∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ Chevalley.R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)
proof:
have hp : Prime (p : ℤ) := Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp h_H001.1
have h1 : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ 1 := hp.not_dvd_one
intro q
constructor
· intro hq
  induction hq using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem q hq =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨1, b, hb, by simp⟩
  | algebraMap a => exact ⟨a, 1, h1, by simp⟩
  | add q r hq hr iq ir =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := iq
    obtain ⟨c, d, hd, rfl⟩ := ir
    have hb0 : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show b ≠ 0 from fun h => hb (h ▸ dvd_zero _))
    have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 from fun h => hd (h ▸ dvd_zero _))
    refine ⟨a*d+c*b, b*d, fun h => (hp.dvd_mul.mp h).elim hb hd, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    field_simp
  | mul q r hq hr iq ir =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := iq
    obtain ⟨c, d, hd, rfl⟩ := ir
    refine ⟨a*c, b*d, fun h => (hp.dvd_mul.mp h).elim hb hd, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    ring
· rintro ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (Chevalley.R p).mul_mem ((Chevalley.R p).algebraMap_mem a)
    (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)

checked : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ)
  (ell : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    (FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧
        Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
          h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧
            h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧
              x * y - y * x = h ∧
                (∃ w, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = ↑ell • w) ∧
                  ∀ (W : Submodule ℂ V),
                    Chevalley.stable W x → Chevalley.stable W y → Chevalley.stable W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) →
      ((∃ d b B, ∀ (i : Fin d), ↑(b i) = B i) ∧
          ∀ (r : ℕ), Chevalley.preserves M (Chevalley.dp x r) ∧ Chevalley.preserves M (Chevalley.dp y r)) →
        0 < ell.toNat + 1 ∧
            Fintype.card (Chevalley.Index ell) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
              Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
                ((∀ (t : ℕ), h ((y ^ t) v) = (↑ell - 2 * ↑t) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
                    ∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (↑t * (↑ell - ↑t + 1)) • (y ^ (t - 1)) v) ∧
                  (∃ b, ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                    (∀ (t : ℕ), ell.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
                      Chevalley.stringActions ell x y h (Chevalley.e y v) ∧
                        Chevalley.dividedActions ell (Chevalley.dp x) (Chevalley.dp y) (Chevalley.e y v) →
          ∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ Chevalley.R p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b
